sourcesContent: import dagre from 'dagre' import type { Node, Edge } from '@vue-flow/core' export function useAutoLayout() { function applyLayout( nodes: Node[], edges: Edge[], direction: 'TB' | 'LR' = 'LR' ) { if (nodes.length === 0) return [] const g = new dagre.graphlib.Graph() g.setGraph({ rankdir: direction, nodesep: 80, ranksep: 150, marginx: 50, marginy: 50, }) g.setDefaultEdgeLabel(() => ({})) nodes.forEach((node) => { g.setNode(node.id, { width: 220, height: 120 }) }) edges.forEach((edge) => { g.setEdge(edge.source, edge.target) }) dagre.layout(g) return nodes.map((node) => { const pos = g.node(node.id) return { ...node, position: { x: pos.x - 110, y: pos.y - 60, }, } }) } return { applyLayout } }
